sentence: A spinning wheel that picks a random driver from a pool of volunteers for each open airport pickup or dropoff slot, with one slot per driver.
use_when: A group needs to assign drivers to airport pickups and dropoffs at random
Several ride slots are open and each person should take at most one
People want a fair, visible draw instead of arguing over who drives
Drivers need to join or leave the pool and give back a slot later
dont_use_when: Picking one random winner or a single choice with no slots to fill
Splitting a bill or tracking who owes money
Scheduling by availability or voting on times, where people choose their own slot
